propositions: Eight unguarded pytest lanes in .github/workflows lack per-test hang detection; a deadlocked test can hide silently behind dots with no traceback or culprit identified.

Per-test timeout budgets must be calibrated per-lane from historical runtime data with 10x the observed mean duration (floored at 300s) to allow legitimate live-service variance without truncating intentional large sweeps.

The parity assertion in test_ci_workflow_parity.py must exhaustively detect pytest invocation across all four command forms (bare pytest, pytest -m, python -m pytest, path-prefixed variants) and verify both --timeout and --timeout-method=thread are present in every pytest step.

External integration lanes (llm_live 900s, live-jira 600s, langfuse 300s, jira-dc 900s) and offline unit lanes (_eval-discipline, _optionality 300s each) require calibrated per-test budgets to guard against hangs during C-level blocking calls where signal-based timeouts cannot fire.
